verdict.rationale: Rainforest emits webhooks when resource statuses change and documents subscribing to events for several resources, including on-prem delivery. Its docs also show a no-code Zapier integration that triggers workflows on events such as a merchant application moving to Needs Information. Rule-to-action automation is therefore possible, but it depends on the platform's own webhook handlers or a third-party tool like Zapier, not a native rules engine. missing for 10: native in-product rule/trigger definition, documented conditional logic or action catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
